# Local page fixtures

These files are saved copies used only to test LearnAble on pages that are not Savanna. They are not part of the product.

- `wai-bad-before.html` is the W3C WAI Before-and-After Demonstration, “before” home page, from https://www.w3.org/WAI/demos/bad/before/home.html. W3C document licence.
- `wikipedia-ada.html` is the Parsoid HTML for the English Wikipedia article “Ada Lovelace”, from the Wikimedia REST API. Text is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike Licence. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace
- `govuk-help.html` is a saved copy of https://www.gov.uk/help. Crown copyright, Open Government Licence. Styles and scripts still point at GOV.UK and are not vendored.

The session token that arrived with the GOV.UK download was removed.
